title: PROGRAMME_6 INDUSTRIES IN THE COUNTY
subject: social-studies
text:
1 ” to allow audio playback INDUSTRIES IN THE COUNTY *Music* Hello learner, Welcome to a social studies lesson for grade 4 learners. Today, we shall learn about industries in the county. Your radio teacher is Esther Simaloi. Welcome to the program. *Music*

2 ” to allow audio playback Hello Grade 4 Learner. Welcome to our social studies lesson. In today's lesson, we shall learn about industries in the county. We shall also learn the benefits of industries in the county. Learner, what is an industry? What is an industry? #Bell# An industry is a place where raw materials are processed into finished products. Raw materials, on the other hand, are things that we use to make finished products. Some of the raw materials that we use include Maize. The finished product is maize flour. Coffee berries . The finished product is coffee. Tea leaves. The finished product is tea. Trees. The finished product is paper. Limestone. The finished product is cement. Clay soil. The finished product are pots. Learner, listen to the following sounds. *Sounds * Learner, can you tell what the sounds were? #Bell# Listen to the first sound. *sound 1* That is the sound of a sewing machine. Where do we use the sewing machines? Where, do we use the sewing machines? #Bell# What do we make using the sewing machines? What do we make using the sewing machines? #Bell# Tailors use the sewing machines. We use the sewing machines to make clothes and also repair them. Learner, listen to the next sound. * Sound 2* That is the sound of people working in the Jua kali industry. They make items using locally available materials like metal. They make things like sufurias, frying pans, wheelbarrows, metal boxes and many others. They work in small sheds or open spaces. Jua Kali Industries are important in our county. Learner, which industries are found in your county? Which industries are found in your county? #Bell# What do these industries produce? What do these industries produce? #Bell# What are the raw materials used to produce the finished product? What are the raw materials used to produce the finished product? #Bell#

3 ” to allow audio playback Listen to the next sound. *Sound 3* What do you hear? What do you hear? #Bell# What is being made? What is being made? #Bell# Good. That is the sound of a milling machine. A milling machine is used to grind maize into flour. Maize is the raw material that is ground to make flour, which is the finished product. Maize is the raw material that is ground to make maize flour, which is the finished product. Maize is grown in the farms. It is harvested and dried. Then it is taken to the milling industry where it is ground into maize flour. It is packaged and sold in the shops and supermarkets. Learner, which food do you cook using the maize flour in your home? Which food do you cook using maize flour in your home? #Bell# Very well. Those are good answers. Pottery industry is another industry in the county. This is the making of pots using clay. Clay soil is the raw material used in this industry. Which is the finished product. #Bell# Good. I hope your answers included pots and jars. The people who model the pots are called Potters. This pots are used for Fetching water, Storing water, Cooking food, Storing food, and Storing grains, Paper making is another industry. The raw material in paper manufacturing is trees. Not all trees are used to make paper. Trees are planted. They are harvested and taken to the industry. The raw wood is turned into Watery soap called Pulp. It is then flattened and then dried. This is the paper we use to make books we use to read and to write on. What are the benefits of industries in our county? #Bell# Industries in our county have the following benefits. Creation of employment. In industries, people are employed to work. This helps the people to earn a living, thus improve their living standards. Another benefit is provide a ready market for raw materials. Industries provide a ready market for raw materials. Another benefits is industries help in the development of towns. It helps in the development of towns. Another benefit is that industries provide better roads, electricity and railway lines. And lastly, the county government, earns income. To conclude the lesson. With the help of your parents or guardians, find out the types of industries found in your county. Find out the types of industries found in your county. And with that, we come to the end of our lesson for today. Until next time, Goodbye.
